thread:
Anya: Heads up — preflight prompt-eval showed a small regression on the summarizer bundle during canary. Not a hard fail but above our noise floor. deploybot posted details below.
Ryan: can you paste the delta and the threshold?
Anya: quick paste:
```
metric: rouge_l_mean
baseline: 0.276
canary: 0.253
delta: -0.023 (threshold -0.02)
notes: high variance on long-doc subset, sample size 120
```
Sam: ugh that's slightly over. Change window ends in 2h. Are we rolling back or asking for an exception?
Linus: eyeballing examples — most failures are length normalization edge-cases from the new tokenizer tweak. Might be safe to pin route to old model for 24h while we bisect.
Anya: Product says we need the feature live for demo at EOD. Ops would prefer pin + quick rollback if anything else breaks.
Ryan: Deploybot, can you run gated-release-check --override-cause "change-window-demo" and show gates?
deploybot: automatic checks start...
deploybot: eval-gate: noise_exceed=true
deploybot: affected_suites=long-doc-summarizer, headline-copy
deploybot: recommended_action=hold_or_pin
qa-bot: regression_severity=minor
qa-bot: suggested_mitigation=route-pin-to-v1 for canary_samples >= 0.8
Sam: Proposal: request a one-time gate exception to rollforward with immediate route-pin policy (traffic split 80% new / 20% v1) and strict monitoring + auto-fallback within 15m. We can run a targeted bisect on long-doc tokenizer in parallel.
Linus: I can prepare the bisect patch and a quick quantized build; if quality continues to trend down after 30min, we auto-rollback.
Anya: Who signs the exception? Need eng-release + oncall ops signoff.
Ryan: I'll sign from eng-release, @Linus please confirm you'll watch for 30m and be ready to hotfix.
Linus: confirmed.
Anya: Ops @Sam, can you file the release exception with change window justification and set the deploybot override flag? Include the quick monitoring dashboard: /dash/eng/summarizer/short-window
Sam: filing now. ticket: REL-3419. Adding deploybot override.
Sam: deploybot override submitted: override_id=ovr-20240418-77, expires_in=2h, auto-fallback=15m
deploybot: override accepted. rolling canary to 80% per policy.
Anya: monitoring hooks in place. If rouge_l_mean delta worsens past -0.035 we force rollback.
Ryan: thanks everyone. postmortem note: if bisect pinpoints tokenizer tweak, we should add a targeted prompt-suite focusing on long-doc length norms before next canary.
Linus: noted. Starting the bisect now.
Anya: closing thread for now — will update if we hit auto-fallback or need a manual rollback. :thumbsup:
